sections.text:
There are eight up to isolated inputs to the relay that can be 
arranged to operate up to alternative ladder inputs, which perform functions 
assigned to them in the ladder diagram, as determined by the setting of the 
INPUT MASKS and so making maximum use of the available control inputs. Software 
filtering is applied to eliminate the adverse effects of induced ac signals in 
the external wiring eight programmable output relays are provided on all models.

These relays can be arranged to operate in response to any, or all, of up to 16 
alternative ladder outputs, whose function is assigned in the ladder diagram, by 
suitably setting the OUTPUT MASKS. In addition there is a watchdog relay for 
external indication of equipment failure/healthy status. Measurements are only 
available in relays including check synchronism features (KAVS and KAVR). These 
relays have two voltage transformers for measuring line and bus bar voltages.

Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance staff carry the suitable 
 safety ID category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety Helmet.
Line isolation must be done.
Tools and Equipment
ISA test set type ART/3 or Omicron
Voltmeter, and Ammeter
Test plug test leads
Work to be carried out
Relays Preparation
Review the manual and drawings
Prepare the previous or commissioning results of the relay testing
Check the wires of the relay by hand.
Check the AC source is available to the tester.
Check the existence of the DC sources in panels.
Disconnect the outputs of the relay and connect one of them to the 
 timer of the tester.
Check all the leads used in tests.

Steps
Connect the voltage leads of a tester unit to the relay points according

Inject

Repeat the steps for each pair of points according to the test sheet.
Record the results.
